evidence: The building clearly shows its large foreshortened tiled roof slopes (rows 1-42 on the main wings) above the vertical timber-framed walls (rows 43-74 on side wings, down to 105 on the central entrance projection), with distinct roof edge lines, eave shadows under the roof/beams, and inset doors and windows.

style.evidence: The candidate is a quantized/flattened version of the Beodeul reference: the plaster wall panels are completely flat single-colour fills (losing all plaster speckle and subtle shading from the reference), the roof and wood ramps are reduced to 2-3 steps, the chimney lost its opening and shading, and a uniform near-black outline wraps the entire exterior silhouette.
